content: {"like":["Enthusiastic fan of iconic actresses, especially Marilyn Monroe, valuing classic cinema as treasured collectibles.","Appreciates high-quality, emotionally engaging crime dramas and thrillers that keep viewers glued to the screen.","Values strong performances from actors like Hugh Jackman and Jake Gyllenhaal, enjoying their best work.","Enjoys well-crafted shows and movies with excellent cinematography and overall good storytelling.","Shows a strong attachment to beloved media, often purchasing items on sale and expressing deep affection for favorite stars."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that mocks or disrespects other cultures, preferring respectful and inclusive storytelling.","Avoids humor that feels forced or inauthentic, such as that from Ricky Gervais, preferring genuine comedy.","Rejects films that are disjointed, boring, or lack meaningful plot development.","Dislikes misleading or exaggerated marketing claims, such as false accolades or ratings.","Shows intolerance for absurd or nonsensical content, such as bizarre or irrelevant anecdotes."]}
